text:
aly: quick FYI I opened PR #4632 to tidy the bootcamp quicklaunch: unify env var, refresh the Node + Python snippets to the new client shape, and add a one-line Docker deploy for live labs. Pls peek.

marc: which env var did you standardize on? we still have REDWOOD_KEY and API_TOKEN floating around in slides.

aly: REDWOOD_API_KEY only. added a tiny migration note for LEGACY_TOKEN and a single CI example showing how to map old envs.

zoe: can you paste the Node snippet here so I can sanity-check the close/return shape?

aly: sure - from the PR:

```
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hello bootcamp' });
console.log(r.output.text);
await client.close();
```

aly: also added a tiny Python sync example and a one-liner Docker run used in the lab: `docker build -t quicklaunch . && docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY quicklaunch`.

marc: quick asks: 1) change console log to `r.output.text` (you did, good), 2) mention Node >=18 and Python >=3.10 in the prereq, 3) keep streaming out of the main quickstart; add as an "advanced" appendix.

zoe: found two broken links in the README (private deploy guide anchor + key rotation). pasted corrected URLs in PR comments. also suggest a one-line troubleshooting bullet: 401 -> check REDWOOD_API_KEY + org allowlist.

aly: updated prereqs, moved streaming to an appendix, and fixed the links. added a short curl example for minting ephemeral tokens for workshop folks.

docs-bot: PR #4632 labeled docs/bootcamp and assigned to aly. staged preview will be available.

aly: thanks all. plan to merge after zoe verifies the link fixes and marc gives a quick thumbs on the examples. If anyone wants the Docker demo during Friday's session, say so here. :rocket:
